text:
alex: FYI PR #4901 is up — updates changelog for model v2 deprecation and adds migration steps for v2q (quantized) plus SDK snippets. Need reviews and a merge plan.
tess: assigning @liam and @anya for docs review. Can we get the docs preview URL?
ci-bot: docs preview: https://preview.redwood-inference.internal/changes/4901 — build succeeded ✅
liam: Quick skim. Please add a short note in the release notes about behavior change: default routing policy now prefers quantized variant when "prefer_quant": true is set; that can affect latency profiles.
anya: Will add a short warning and an example CLI command. Also adding a Python snippet for the SDK migration.
anya: ```python
# old
resp = client.chat.create(model="v2", messages=msgs)
# new - explicit quantized model & runtime hint
resp = client.chat.create(model="v2q", messages=msgs, runtime_options={"quant": "int8"})
```
alex: Good. Can we gate merge on the nightly canary (11:00 PT) + 15m observation window? Want to watch error-rate and cost-per-token metrics.
tess: Yes — plan: merge between 11:20-11:30 PT if canary is clean. I'll add the merge window to the PR and set the branch protection hold.
eng-runtime: Noted. I'll double-check the suggested runtime_options name. We use "quant" in the runtime API but the SDK maps it to "quant_mode" — docs should show post-mapping code.
liam: thanks — please make the snippet copy-paste accurate to the published SDK.
docs-bot: Editorial: in migration step 3, change "you must" -> "we recommend" for nonbreaking optimization. Also check the heading levels for the migration note (H3 -> H4).
anya: updated wording and headings in the branch.
ci-bot: i18n job re-run: passed ✅
alex: one more: include a rollback CLI example for aliasing in case we need to revert quickly.
anya: added rollback example: ```bash
# map alias back to old model temporarily
redwood model alias set v2q v2 --temporary
```
liam: small test snippet for function-calling behavior attached to PR: shows content-type header change.
tess: added @eng-runtime as approver so they can sign off on runtime naming.
eng-runtime: Approve from runtime side once SDK snippet is updated to use "quant_mode". No other runtime changes expected.
alex: final plan: merge after canary (11:00 PT) and 15m hold. If any anomalies, abort and we'll iterate. I'll post final comment on the PR with the preview link and merge window before merging. Thanks all :rocket:
summary: coordination for changelog+migration PR for model v2 -> v2q: reviewers, CI preview, merge window, SDK/CLI snippets, rollback
